biography:
As Vice President of Business Development at Virtus, I lead strategic growth across the EMEA region with a focus on the data center and cloud infrastructure ecosystem. With deep expertise shaped by my time at Amazon Web Services (AWS) and other industry-leading organizations, I bring a customer-centric, data-driven approach to scaling cloud and digital infrastructure solutions in one of the world’s most dynamic and competitive markets.

At Virtus, I am responsible for country and site selection as well as new market entries across EMEA. I lead cross-functional initiatives to identify, evaluate, and secure strategic locations for data center development — with a strong track record of sourcing mega campuses powered by green energy and aligned with long-term sustainability and digital transformation goals.

As a third-culture kid who has lived and worked across multiple countries, I thrive in constantly changing environments and bring a truly global perspective to business development. My multilingual background and cultural agility enable me to build trust and foster long-term partnerships across diverse markets and stakeholder groups.

Throughout my career, I’ve accelerated regional expansion, built strategic alliances, and successfully navigated the complex needs of hyperscalers, cloud providers, and enterprise customers. I’m passionate about sustainable, innovation-driven growth and about helping organizations realize the full potential of cloud and digital infrastructure.

Let’s connect if you’re working at the intersection of cloud, data centers, sustainability, and global growth.
